title: Cats, dogs, raw meat and Toxoplasma: online survey of Czech and Slovak adults (Flegr lab)
setting: Online survey, adults with a past Toxoplasma test
features: age, male, residence_size, dogs, dog_bitten, cats, cat_bitten, cat_scratched, cat_love, cat_touch, raw_meat, garden_soil, unwashed_vegetables, rural_childhood, untreated_water, sexual_risk
note: Self-reported result of an earlier serological test; direct exposures (cats, raw meat, soil, water, unwashed vegetables).

title: Past Toxoplasma and Borrelia infections, personality and cognition (Flegr lab)
features: borreliosis, physSickness, mentalSickness, education, Iq, memoryYesNo, timeStroop, precisionStroop, Extroversion, Agreeableness, Conscientiousness, EmotionalStability, OpennessExperiences, PathogenDisgust, SexualDisgust, MoralDisgust, InjuryDisgust, Machiavellianism, Narcissism, Psychopathy, Tribalism, EconomicEgalitarianism, CulturalLiberalism, AntiAuthoritarianism, age, sex
note: toxo: 2 = tested negative, 3 = tested positive (self-reported). Features are mostly personality / cognition (possible consequences).

title: Toxoplasma and physical health, stress and anxiety (stress-coping hypothesis, Flegr lab)
features: sex, age, livingNow, physHealthToday_1, mentHealthToday_1, Borelioza, Anxiety, Stress

title: Toxoplasma and CMV vs intelligence and memory in university students
features: sex, age, cmv, Rh, totalIQ, totalKnowl, verbalIQ, verbalKnowl, numericIQ, numericKnowl, figuralIQ, figuralKnowl, crystalIQ, fluidIQ, memory, meiliLocaliz, meiliYesNo, meiliFreer, srtMeanFil, acoustPrepYes, acoustPrepNo, visualPrepYes, visualPrepNo, corectNoReactA, noCorectNoReactA, timeA, corectNoReactB, noCorectNoReactB, timeB
note: Toxoplasma IgG measured in the lab; CMV IgG and Rh factor kept as biomarkers; cognitive scores are outcomes.

title: Toxoplasma and CMV: longitudinal study of cognitive change
features: duration_between_periods_years, sex, T1_age, T2_age, CMV, T1_fluid_intelligence, T2_fluid_intelligence, Dif_fluid_intelligence, T1_crystallized_intelligence, T2_crystallized_intelligence, Dif_crystallized_intelligence, T1_associative_memory, T2_associative_memory, Dif_associative_memory, T1_spacial_memory, T2_spacial_memory, Dif_spacial_memory, T1_recognition_memory, T2_recognition_memory, Dif_rec

features: sex, age, relationship, resid_child, raw_meat, garden_soil, vegetables, cat_breeding, cat_number
